description: This file implements a ParallelPipeline class for concurrent frame processing, managing multiple sub-pipelines, synchronization of system frames, and lifecycle events in a media processing framework.

classes.name: ParallelPipeline
classes.description: A class that manages multiple sub-pipelines for concurrent frame processing, including lifecycle management, frame synchronization, and duplicate filtering.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ParallelPipeline with multiple processor lists, creating corresponding sub-pipelines with sources and sinks.

methods.name: processors
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-processors (sub-pipelines) contained within this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: entry_processors
methods.description: Returns the list of entry processors, which are the first processors in each sub-pipeline.

methods.name: processors_with_metrics
methods.description: Collects and returns processors capable of generating metrics from all sub-pipelines.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the parallel pipeline and all its sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources for the parallel pipeline and all sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame across all sub-pipelines, handling synchronization for system frames.

methods.name: _parallel_push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the pipeline if it hasn't been processed before, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _pipeline_sink_push_frame
methods.description: Handles frames from sub-pipelines, managing synchronization for system frames and pushing them when all sub-pipelines have processed them.
